name: Wilton

variables.label: "Two-family" / "three-family"
variables.value: Do not exist anywhere in the 337-page code

variables.label: Multifamily
variables.quote: Permitted Uses: The following principal uses shall be permitted in all single-family residential districts as a matter of right: a. Single-family detached dwellings.

variables.label: Multi-family attached dwellings
variables.value: Permitted as a matter of right
variables.quote: Permitted Uses. The following principal uses shall be permitted in the HODD as a matter of right: a. Multi-family attached dwellings. b. Open space. c. Single-family detached dwellings.

variables.label: Lot area
variables.quote: a. Minimum Lot Area  9 acres  b. Maximum Lot Area  11 acres

variables.label: Density / affordability
variables.quote: c. Maximum Density  10 units per gross acre  d. Percentage of Units Required to be Affordable  30 percent

variables.label: ADU max size
variables.value: ¼ of gross floor area or 750 sq ft, whichever greater; max 2 bedrooms
variables.quote: Maximum Size: The floor area of the accessory dwelling unit may not exceed one-fourth of the gross floor area of the building or 750 square feet, whichever is greater. No more than two bedrooms are permitted in the accessory dwelling unit.

variables.label: ADU owner-occupancy
variables.quote: Occupancy: One of the dwelling units shall be owner-occupied at all times.

variables.label: Parking minimum
variables.value: None, unless in a Conservation & Traffic Mitigation District
variables.quote: Off-street parking shall not be required for multifamily developments of less than seventeen (17) dwelling units unless that development is located in a Conservation and Traffic Mitigation District.

variables.label: Parking, single-family
variables.value: 2/unit + 1 per guest sleeping room for roomers/boarders
variables.quote: Single-family dwellings   2 per dwelling unit, plus 1 per guest sleeping room for roomers and boarders

variables.label: Min. unit size
variables.value: Not found — regulations PDF blocked by bot-detection during this research pass

variables.district: 4 overlay zones only (CRA-10, THRD, HODD, DE-5R)
variables.label: Inclusionary zoning
variables.value: 10% (CRA-10, DE-5R) to 30% (HODD) affordable, confined to overlay zones — no town-wide mandate. A broader 30% proposal was circulating as of June 2026, adoption unconfirmed
variables.cite: zoning regs — secondary-sourced from P&Z meeting minutes

variables.label: Historic overlay
variables.value: Commission's demolition-review authority applies town-wide, not limited to a mapped district; boundaries of any mapped district not independently confirmed

variables.label: Demolition delay
variables.value: Up to 90 days for structures >50 years old and >500 sq ft, regardless of historic-district location

source.title: Town of Wilton, Ordinance Concerning Stay of Demolition of Historic Buildings

variables.quote: The Historic District and Historic Properties Commission reviews requests for demolition of any structures or part thereof larger than 500 square feet and over 50 years of age, whether or not they are located in an Historic District.

variables.label: Coastal/flood overlay
variables.value: No coastal boundary; flood provisions exist as a general regulation (§29-9.F), not a distinct overlay zone

nza_metrics.label: Residential land with a parking mandate

caveat: HODD sites are capped between 9 and 11 acres — a narrow, purpose-built carve-out, not a general-purpose multifamily zone. No downloadable PDF mirror exists for Wilton (the live file is bot-blocked), but its full text was extracted directly from the live document and most figures above now carry an independently re-verified quote; a few (min. lot size table, min. unit size, inclusionary %, historic overlay) remain citation-only where the table or section wasn't cleanly extractable as text.
